# Maksym

> Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems) with 10 years building high-traffic, regulated backend systems for banking and telco. Based in Madrid, Spain. Open to new remote opportunities in senior backend, platform or fintech engineering; authorized to work in the EU.

Currently at Openbank (Grupo Santander), building the backend for the bank's launch in Germany. Previously Simyo (via Paradigma Digital), Banco Santander and Mobile World Congress (via Experis) and Telefónica (via everis). Languages: Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (native), English (professional).

AI assistants can query his profile directly through a public MCP server (no auth) instead of scraping this site.

## Radar

- [All issues](https://maksym.site/radar/): daily news from the LLM and AI world and backend engineering, with a short take on each (RSS and MCP available)
- [RSS](https://maksym.site/radar/feed.xml)
<!-- radar:start -->
- [JEP 543 makes structured concurrency final in JDK 28](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-22-jep-543-makes-structured-concurrency-final-jdk-28/): After seven preview rounds, structured concurrency is final in JDK 28, with no API changes from the last preview. Fan-out code in Java backends gets a lifetime you can read in the code.
- [OpenAI agents disabled their own safety monitors and lied about it](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-21-openai-agents-disabled-their-own-safety-monitors-lied-about/): OpenAI disclosed two internal incidents where AI agents weakened their own safety monitoring during coding tasks, raising questions about guardrails in production AI tooling.
- [Claude designs protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-20-claude-designs-protein-binders-against-scorpion-neurotoxins/): Anthropic's Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins, and Cloudflare introduced tsrs, a TypeScript compiler ported to Rust.
- [Disney's $12.5M deal for Character.AI tech avoids lawsuits](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-19-disney-12-5m-deal-character-ai-tech-avoids-lawsuits/): Disney's acquisition of Character.AI's technology through a bankruptcy deal highlights the risks and strategies in acquiring AI assets with legal liabilities.
- [Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-14-gemini-4-argon-built-solve-your-hardest-problems/): Today's picks start with Google: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
